mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(end_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as name, CAST(COALESCE(SUM(course_count), 0) AS SIGNED) as value FROM edu_salary WHERE end_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{weeks} WEEK) AND status = 1 AND teacher_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY end_date ORDER BY end_date ASC
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(course_count), 0) FROM edu_salary WHERE YEARWEEK(end_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(CURDATE(), 1) AND status = 1 AND teacher_name IS NOT NULL
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(course_count), 0) FROM edu_salary WHERE YEARWEEK(end_date, 1) = YEARWEEK(DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 1 WEEK), 1) AND status = 1 AND teacher_name IS NOT NULL
